Companion Animal Travel Desk basics

Aurelia Skyways keeps companion travel planning steady and simple. If you are traveling with a pet, this guide gives the main points to check before you head to the skyport. The goal is to help you move through the process with less stress and more confidence.

Start by gathering the care items your pet needs for the trip. Make sure the carrier is secure, familiar, and easy to manage. It also helps to keep documents close at hand, since the team may need to review them before departure. Clear preparation makes the day easier for you and kinder for your pet.

Traveler note: <<FACT F010>> Bring only what is needed and follow the staff guidance at the desk. If your pet needs extra attention, the team will explain the next steps in a calm, stepwise way.

At the quarantine area, staff may give you a simple handoff plan and explain how your pet will be cared for on arrival. Traveler note: <<FACT F027>> Please stay with the instructions shared by the crew and wait for the full review before moving on.

If you need a break during the journey, use the pet relief area when directed by the airport team. Traveler note: <<FACT F014>> Keep your pet leashed or safely contained until the staff says it is okay to enter.

If anything feels unclear, tell the desk team right away. They listen carefully, check the situation, and bring in a supervisor when needed. That way, concerns are handled without rush and with steady support.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through Aurelia Skyways support.
